name: kashlink-video
description: KashLink demo video for Arc Microgrants, built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render KashLinkDemo out/kashlink-demo.raw.mp4 && npm run master
scripts.master: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/kashlink-demo.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/kashlink-demo.mp4 && rm out/kashlink-demo.raw.mp4
